takeaways: Azure Backup is not immutable by default; soft delete, multi-user authorization and vault lock must be enabled and tested in that order.
The real threat to backups is IAM design: contributors, owners, shadow admins and automation that can both deploy and purge.
Separate duties with distinct roles, narrowly scoped managed identities, PIM elevation, policy-enforced retention floors and alerts on destructive backup operations.
hook: Your backup jobs show green, yet one over-privileged identity can delete or quietly expire every recovery point. This episode is for Azure administrators and security teams responsible for ransomware recovery. You learn the common attack paths and a three-step hardening plan with soft delete, multi-user authorization, vault lock and identity separation.
